scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client,smee -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w shared -- --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client" "npm run smee"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run start -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
